public_rationale: The contemporary research documents a specific gap between producing reports from images and handling prior clinical information reliably. The workflow account also describes separate products with different functions. Together they support the caution that selected successes do not establish whole-job competence. They do not support a broader claim that AI could not process clinical text.
limitations: The primary study covers chest-image report generation, not every radiology system.
The evidence supports a distinction between capabilities, not permanent limits on AI.
